mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized hepatically and naproxen may displace albendazole from protein binding, increasing albendazole active metabolite (albendazole sulfoxide) concentrations; additionally, both can cause GI irritation and naproxen may impair renal function affecting drug clearance.
action: Monitor for increased albendazole toxicity and GI adverse effects; consider gastroprotection with PPI; assess renal function periodically during concurrent use.
